content.rendered:
Shop for your school November 18-24, mention Hawks View Elementary at checkout and Mudpuddles will donate 20% of your purchase back to Hawks View Elementary! Get some early holiday shopping done and raise money for the school at the same time! You will find the flyer HERE.

Where: Mudpuddles Toys & Books, 16420 SW Langer Dr, Sherwood

When: November 18-24

Hours: Monday-Saturday 10am-6pm and Sunday 11am-5pm
